name: smwmusic-torpedo-fire-emblem-genealogy-of-the-holy-war-remix
title: Torpedo (Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War Remix)
description:
The classic Super Famicompo 4 tune, now remixed in a drastically different style. From serious contemplation to grooving out to a new beat, this Torpedo definitely took a wrong turn on the way to its target and ended up in a different time period; but that's not necessarily a bad thing, is it?

There is an option to toggle between a looping version of this song, as well as one that does not loop and includes an ending similar to the original song.

There also is an echo toggle. Un-enabled the echo will be reduced to work with #optimized, but you can have the intended echo at the cost of being incompatible with Thunder, Bonus End, and Yoshi.
